tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Blue Charcoal, the brand's deep ink. Dark-theme ground; light-theme text. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: harmony
tokens.usage: Harmony Green, the brand hue. Glows, the live dot, primary-button rim, chart highlight. Never as text on light grounds (use accent).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Text on folder and on the primary button; sheet cards behind a folder.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything; the aurora glows sit on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque cards, the sidebar, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a surface: chart plot area, table stripes, inactive segments.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted glass panels over the canvas; always pair with backdrop blur and glass-edge.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered or raised glass: icon buttons, the active segment, tooltips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, chart grid.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, dotted progress tracks, timeline ticks. Meets 3:1 as a control border on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on canvas, surface, surface-2 and glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, axis ticks, metadata on canvas, surface, surface-2 and glass (6.5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative separators only; not for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive green as text or icon: links, active nav label, positive deltas. On canvas, surface, glass and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: chips, selected rows, active nav item.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill (switch thumb label, small solid badges).

tokens.name: folder-hi
tokens.usage: Top-left light of the folder panel. Only large text (24px+) sits here.

tokens.name: folder
tokens.usage: Body of the folder panel; the signature green glass card. White and on-folder-muted text sit here.

tokens.name: folder-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom-right shade of the folder panel and the core of the primary button.

tokens.name: on-folder
tokens.usage: Text and icons on folder, folder-deep and the primary button.

tokens.name: on-folder-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on folder and folder-deep (4.8:1 on folder).

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Soft green halo: primary button bloom, live dot pulse, chart now-marker.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Savings, cleared bids, healthy status. Always with a word or sign (+, ▲).

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, failed bids, overdraw. Always with a word or sign (−, ▼).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Schedule deviation, data delay, pending approval.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind negative text.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: series-grid
tokens.usage: Chart series: grid supply from the DISCOM (Harmony scheme). Warm sand, the cost source.

tokens.name: series-iex
tokens.usage: Chart series: power exchange (IEX DAM/RTM). The hero series of the Harmony scheme.

tokens.name: series-solar
tokens.usage: Chart series: solar (Harmony scheme).

tokens.name: series-battery
tokens.usage: Chart series: local battery discharge (Harmony scheme).

tokens.usage: Chart series: government / shared battery.

tokens.name: series-wind
tokens.usage: Chart series: wind (Harmony scheme).

tokens.name: series-hydro
tokens.usage: Chart series: hydro (Harmony scheme).
